title: Design System: Stint (public site)
source: docs/assets/site.css; companion to .impeccable/DESIGN-site.md (root DESIGN.md is the native app's engineering doc)

display.purpose: Landing headline only, white on night, max 11em.

headline.purpose: Landing section heads and the trust statement.

title.purpose: Prose h2 and Get panel headings.

lede.purpose: Under the display, muted on night.

label.purpose: Uppercase TOC and footer column headings, Requirements label.

replica.purpose: Menu bar, badge, popover replica and toast only, so they read as macOS.

shadows.name: button-light
shadows.purpose: White button on night; hover 0 12px 28px -10px rgba(4, 3, 16, 0.7).

shadows.name: stage-window
shadows.purpose: Main window screenshot on the hero stage.

shadows.name: toast
shadows.purpose: Purple toast pill in a panel.

shadows.name: glow-hero
shadows.value: radial-gradient(42rem 24rem at 78% 18%, rgba(100, 56, 224, 0.42), transparent 70%), radial-gradient(30rem 20rem at 12% 42%, rgba(72, 84, 214, 0.22), transparent 70%)
shadows.purpose: Light source on night grounds (hero; page head uses a smaller pair).

motion.name: glow-drift
motion.value: drift 22s ease-in-out infinite alternate; to { transform: translate3d(-4%, 3%, 0) scale(1.06) }

motion.name: hero-rise
motion.value: rise 0.9s ease-out both; from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(14px); filter: blur(6px) }; delays 0.08s, stage 0.18s at 1.1s
motion.purpose: One orchestrated landing entrance, only with JS.

motion.name: popover-open
motion.value: opacity 0.18s, transform 0.28s ease-out from scale(0.96) translateY(-4px); close 0.14s

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Gate on every animation and smooth scroll.

components.css: .ds-header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 28px; min-height: 64px; padding: 0 16px; background: rgba(19, 18, 46, 0.96); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(220, 214, 255, 0.12); color: #f4f3fb; font-family: 'Work Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-brand { color: #fff; font-weight: 650; font-size: 1.125rem; letter-spacing: -0.01em; text-decoration: none; margin-right: auto; } .ds-header nav { display: flex; gap: 22px; } .ds-header nav a { color: #b9b6d3; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.9375rem; transition: color 0.2s; } .ds-header nav a:hover, .ds-header nav a[aria-current=page] { color: #fff; } .ds-header nav a[aria-current=page] { text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: #a48bf7; text-decoration-thickness: 2px; text-underline-offset: 0.45em; } .ds-header a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 6px; } .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 10px; background: #fff; color: #1d1c39; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9375rem; text-decoration: none; } .ds-pill:hover { background: #f1edff; }

narrative.overview:
The site opens on the product. Every page starts in a night band: deep slate lit by slow purple and indigo glows, a sticky header with the brand on the left and a white Download pill on the right. On the landing page that night becomes a stage: a slice of a Mac desktop with a menu bar strip, Stint's purple-and-slate time badge ticking, and a working popover replica hanging beneath it, the main window screenshot behind. Work Sans is set huge and tight for display, then quiet at reading size.

Below the night, the page follows the visitor's system setting: cool white or deep slate. Content sits in bento panels that hold real UI (popover strips, menu bar style swatches, duration tables, screenshots) and in hairline lists, never in icon tiles. Docs pages swap the stage for a shorter night page head, then a sticky table of contents beside a 70ch prose column.

Density is relaxed on the landing page (sections of 72 to 128px) and calm for reading on docs pages. Depth is soft and ambient; corners are generous; colour is mostly slate, white and one purple, with pink kept to tiny points of life.
keyCharacteristics: Night slate header and hero or page head in both colour schemes; everything below follows `prefers-color-scheme`.
Oversized, tight display type (-0.04em) in self-hosted Work Sans.
A live, clickable product replica instead of a static hero screenshot.
Bento panels and hairline lists carry real UI and real text.
Purple as the single accent; pink only as dots and full stops.
No third-party requests: fonts, script and images are first-party.

rules.name: The Pink Point Rule
rules.body: Pink is a dot: the live-timer dot, a wire node, a hint marker, a headline's full stop. Never a button, a fill, a border or a word.

rules.name: The Night Stays Night Rule
rules.body: The header, the landing stage and the docs page head are night slate in both schemes. Only content below them follows the system.

rules.name: The Accent Swap Rule
rules.body: On light grounds the accent is Stint Purple; on dark grounds it is Night Lilac. Fills stay purple in both.

rules.name: The Tight Top Rule
rules.body: Tracking tightens as size grows: -0.04em display, -0.035em headline, -0.03em title, -0.02em to -0.01em at subhead. Body is untracked.

rules.name: The Tabular Time Rule
rules.body: Every duration or clock uses tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Lit Night Rule
rules.body: Night surfaces gain depth from radial purple (`rgba(100,56,224,0.42 to 0.55)`) and indigo glows, never from shadows.

dos: **Do** open every page on night slate (header plus hero stage or page head) in both schemes, and let everything below follow the system.
**Do** use Stint Purple for fills and Night Lilac for accent text and lines on dark grounds.
**Do** end display and headline statements with a pink full stop when they are sentences (`.`).
**Do** fill panels with real product UI or screenshots of sample data.
**Do** keep Work Sans self-hosted and every asset, script and font first-party.
**Do** use tabular numerals for all times and durations.
donts: **Don't** use pink for buttons, fills, borders or text larger than a full stop.
**Don't** show Teamwork's logo or brand marks; write its name as text, and keep the "independent project, not made or endorsed by Teamwork.com" line.
**Don't** load anything from a third party: no font CDNs, analytics or embeds.
**Don't** use purple `#6438e0` as text on dark grounds; it fails 4.5:1 there.
**Don't** build icon tiles or feature cards with a glyph and a sentence; use real UI or hairline lists.
**Don't** use the system font outside the macOS replica elements.
